entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a FINAL production sprite atlas for an English children's learning game, not a mockup. 12 separate gorgeous premium 3D clay/toy rendered educational illustrations in an EXACT 3-column by 4-row grid. Portrait canvas 1536x2048 or larger high resolution. Every cell has exactly equal size and pure white background; no grid lines, labels, numbers, watermark or text. Each subject is fully contained with 12% white padding; never overlap a cell boundary. Soft studio lighting, crisp clean silhouettes, vivid sophisticated colours, tactile details, dimensional shadows. Friendly expressive characters with correct anatomy, beautiful sculpted objects, consistent high-end animated-film look. Visual meaning must be immediately clear to primary school pupils. No letters or labels. Subjects entirely within their equal square cell.
